title: Underwelming
text: I'm not sure how I'll use most of the items. I like that the box I received clearly supports Etsy businesses, but the items just don't seem very useful to me. I received a frame and a print with a saying, some washi tape and another time of stationary tape, a small journal, and address book, and a book mark. There may have been a few more items I'm not remembering. I was kind of hoping that the items would combine into a fun project to mail to people I care about, but I misunderstood the point of the box.
label: negative
